[Story]
Wang Qiang, Li Ming, and Zhao Min all work in the same company. Recently, there is a division of opinions within the office due to a new policy. Li Ming and Zhao Min are the representatives of these two factions. One day, the company holds an informal gathering, Wang Qiang hears Li Ming discussing the benefits of the new policy, while Zhao Min emphasizes its negative impacts on the other side. At the end of the party, Wang Qiang walks past Zhao Min's table, they look at each other for a while, Wang Qiang gives Zhao Min a slight smile, then turns and walks towards Li Ming. Wang Qiang and Li Ming clink glasses, but his eyes seem to be searching the crowd around.

[Question]
What does Zhao Min do next?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Ignores this matter and focuses on other matters at work, such as preparing for the upcoming project meeting.
B. Thinks about this situation from different angles, understands that Wang Qiang's behavior is not necessarily a denial of her views, but a polite social behavior.
C. Finds a good friend of hers, shares her feelings with them, and seeks their advice and comfort.
D. Directly expresses her views on the new policy to Wang Qiang, trying to resolve her inner unease and opposition through honest communication.
